lines.text: During the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra, a descendant of Aaron the chief priest, came up from Babylon.
Ezra left Babylon on the first day of the first month and arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the ninth month.
Ezra set his heart to study the Law of the LORD, to practice it, and to teach it in Israel.
The king's letter let only priests go with Ezra, and the silver and gold were to buy stone and timber for the walls.

wrong_details.wrong: only priests may go with Ezra
wrong_details.true: any volunteers among the Israelites, including priests and Levites, may go

wrong_details.wrong: buy stone and timber for the walls
wrong_details.true: buy bulls, rams, and lambs with their offerings for the altar

lines.text: Ezra blessed the LORD, the God of his fathers, and gathered the leaders of Israel to return with him.
